The '''Lorell system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region, just outside of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. The system received its name from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorell]] which resided within it.
